# NanoTrasen Colonial Law and Procedure
This page contains all NanoTrasen Colonial Law and Procedure articles.
## Overview:
### Article 1: Station Regulations Covers general station behavior: alert levels, permits, and more.
### Article 2: Colonial Law Covers the list of crimes, searches, procedure for detainment and arrests, contraband classifications and related topics.
### Article 3: Standard Operating Procedure Covers the Standard Operating Procedure for each position hired by NanoTrasen.
### Article 5: Sentencing, Trials, and Hearings Covers the process of convicting criminals.
